name: simforge
description: SimForge: Reusable Remotion + React Three Fiber framework for procedural 3D simulations & vertical video generation

scripts.render:dungeon: remotion render DungeonTrap out/dungeon-trap.raw.mp4 --concurrency=8 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/dungeon-trap.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/dungeon-trap.mp4
scripts.render:boulder: remotion render RollingBoulder out/rolling-boulder.raw.mp4 --concurrency=8 --crf=18 --audio-bitrate=192k && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/rolling-boulder.raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/rolling-boulder.mp4
